iterative_source_discovery_summary.final_coverage_assessment: Strong coverage achieved for the primary target fields. Five westnile.ca.gov Arbobulletin PDFs covering the full August 2024 window have been identified: Bulletin #17 (Week 31, Aug 2), #18 (Week 32, Aug 9), #19 (Week 33, Aug 16), #20 (Week 34, Aug 23), and #21 (Week 35, Aug 30). These provide weekly new case counts and cumulative year-to-date totals with county breakdowns. The Arbobulletin_2024_32.pdf (download_id=5072, a different bulletin also labeled week 32 from iteration 1) provides an additional data point with 112 cumulative human cases from 23 counties. The Placer County press release confirms 54 confirmed cases and 5 deaths statewide at a point in time. The Santa Clara County statement confirms county-level cases. The CIDRAP post references a 5th California WNV death. CDC historic data provides a cross-validation anchor. Hospitalization data remains unconfirmed — this is a known structural gap in CDPH Arbobulletin reporting, not a search failure.
iterative_source_discovery_summary.final_trustworthiness_assessment: High trustworthiness for the primary sources. The westnile.ca.gov Arbobulletins are produced by the CDPH Arboviral Surveillance Program and are the definitive primary source for California WNV human case data. The county health department sources (placer.ca.gov, publichealth.santaclaracounty.gov) are official .gov domains. The CDC historic data page is authoritative for national cross-validation. The CIDRAP source (cidrap.umn.edu) is a well-regarded academic public health news outlet. The avmosquito.org figure (1,466 cases, 320 deaths) has been flagged as a likely cumulative all-time historical total and should not be used as August 2024 data without verification. The Facebook/CIDRAP post is a secondary source and should be corroborated against the primary CIDRAP article URL (cidrap.umn.edu, which appeared in iteration 2 domain counts).
